verdict.rationale: Sift takes data your own application sends through its REST Events, Decisions and Score APIs, plus a JS snippet and mobile SDKs. That model implies it sits independently of any single processor's rails, and the changelog shows a generic $payment_method object. However, no evidence explicitly states support for multiple PSPs, gateways or platforms. missing for 10: explicit documentation of PSP/gateway-agnostic or multi-processor support, named payment-platform integrations, independent or hands-on confirmation of use across mixed payment stacks.
